title: Attempt operational detail
description: Objective: present immutable attempt operational history while keeping narrative transcript explicitly separate from evidence. Deliverable: apps/control-room/src/attempts/attempt-detail.tsx and attempt-detail.test.tsx, showing attempt identity/outcome, current binding/lease epoch as supplied, receipts, bounded journal entries, recovery state, and a transcript available only inside a collapsed-by-default native disclosure labeled “💬 AGENT_REPORTED — narrative, not evidence”. NOT in scope: clean review/acceptance surfaces, transcript promotion to evidence, journal mutation, fetching, routing/mounting, lifecycle/recovery inference, or edits outside the two files. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/control-room typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room exec vitest run src/attempts/attempt-detail.test.tsx.
definitionOfDone: Focused tests prove attempt outcome, authority/binding and lease epoch, receipts, journal entries, recovery state, and transcript are separately labeled operational facts.

The transcript is present only in attempt detail, collapsed by default, keyboard operable, carries the exact AGENT_REPORTED narrative-not-evidence label, and cannot satisfy any verification assertion.
Missing receipt/recovery/provenance facts render UNKNOWN; immutable historical attempt identity is never rewritten or presented as a current successor.
attempt-detail.tsx and attempt-detail.test.tsx are each <=250 physical lines and the exact focused verification command exits 0.
taskRails: Transcript and journal are operational history, not evidence; do not expose transcript props to clean-review modules.
Use native semantic disclosure/controls and stable cr.inspector.* test IDs; no color-only state.
Own and stage only apps/control-room/src/attempts/attempt-detail.tsx and attempt-detail.test.tsx.
